2014_spells.mass-polymorph.description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the effect. An automaton succeeds automatically.
2014_spells.mass-polymorph.effectSummary: Transform a creature or object into a new form
2014_spells.mass-polymorph.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, you transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC to resist the effect; An automaton succeeds automatically. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 hour.
